waypoints.name: Sunrise Mine Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Granite Falls, drive the Mountain Loop Highway east past the Verlot Public Service Center for about 17 miles, then turn right (south) onto Sunrise Mine Road, FS Road 4065, and follow it 2.2 miles to the trailhead at its end, at about 2,340 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park.

waypoints.name: Morning Star Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Leave the Sunrise Mine Trail about half a mile in, just before it crosses the South Fork Stillaguamish, for a faint path up the river's east side past a house-sized boulder to the basin near 3,700 ft. Climb the steep gully directly east, then snowy slabs to the 5,600 ft notch in the southeast ridge; drop into the southeast basin, traverse right below the cliffs, climb the first broad gully to the south ridge and follow it north to the summit.
